lines.say: In the NES version of Double Dragon, the final boss is your own brother.
Technos released it in arcades in 1987, led by Yoshihisa Kishimoto.
The name: Double for two players, and Dragon for Bruce Lee's Enter the Dragon.
Brothers Billy and Jimmy Lee fight the Black Warriors gang to rescue Marian.
But on the NES, there's no co-op story. Billy fights alone, and Jimmy is secretly the gang leader.
The arcade game was America's top-earning arcade game in 1988 and 1989.
